description: Extract all tables detected in a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) workbook, one worksheet per table. Input: the PDF file's contents as a base64-encoded string (max 25 MB, 500 pages; tables need visible ruling lines or clearly aligned columns). Returns a download_url for the .xlsx file (link valid 24 hours) plus the table count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per month.
name: pdf_tables_to_excel
title: Extract PDF tables to Excel
